tool.name: update-settings
tool.description: Updates one or more of: timezone, language, assistantName, addressStyle, preferredReplyLength, aiProvider. At least one field must be provided. There is no arbitrary key/value field — only the listed fields are accepted.

instructions.field_mapping: - timezone — IANA timezone (e.g. Europe/Warsaw, America/New_York, UTC). Must be Intl-supported. - language — conversation language for replies (e.g. Polish, English). - assistantName — the assistant's display name. - addressStyle — how the assistant should address the user. - preferredReplyLength — preferred reply length (e.g. "1-3 sentences"). - aiProvider — one of: openai-codex, openrouter, ollama, opencode-go.

usage_rules.rule: Provide at least one field. Calling update-settings with an empty object is invalid.
Only the provided fields are written. Omitted fields are left untouched.
Use values the user specified and omit unspecified fields.

If the user's message contains BOTH a settings change AND a normal task (mixed intent), apply the settings change and return its result to Main so Main can continue the remaining task with the appropriate specialist.
After a successful update, return the changed effective settings to Main.
If the tool returns an error, report which field/value was rejected.

instructions.mixed_message_handling: When the message is mixed (settings + normal task): - Apply the settings change with update-settings. - Return the result and remaining intent to Main. - Main delegates the remaining task to the appropriate specialist.

example.response: Return the updated UTC timezone setting to Main.

example.message: "use openrouter and switch your language to English"
example.response: Return the updated provider and language settings to Main.

example.message: "remind me to call mom at 5pm and change your name to Bella"
example.response: Return the name change and the remaining reminder intent to Main.
